purpose: Protect verified progress from silent rewind, destructive redesign, or uncheckpointed changes to critical NayaPOWER execution surfaces.

baseline.meaning: Verified repository checkpoint for activation of the protected-progress gate. The baseline is an ancestor requirement, not a claim that downstream product/runtime work is production-proven.

verification_receipt.result: Checkpoint contract, fail-closed anti-rewind rule, protected scope, and GitHub Actions enforcement are present on main. Runtime execution evidence remains a separate proof boundary.

protected_scope.rule: Changes to critical execution architecture require a fresh checkpoint before the next protected change is accepted.

anti_rewind.rule: Current main HEAD must be a descendant of the checkpoint baseline. A rewind, force-push behind the baseline, or replacement history that loses the protected baseline fails closed.

checkpoint_protocol.step_1: Make the smallest necessary protected change.
checkpoint_protocol.step_2: Run the relevant tests and verification evidence.
checkpoint_protocol.step_3: If protected paths changed, create a new checkpoint whose baseline commit is the verified protected-change commit before making another protected change.
checkpoint_protocol.step_4: The checkpoint must never be advanced merely because code exists; verification evidence is required.
checkpoint_protocol.step_5: If evidence is unavailable, leave the system BLOCKED/UNKNOWN rather than advancing the checkpoint.
checkpoint_protocol.step_6: A cold Naya must restore the checkpoint before modifying protected scope.

known_risks: GitHub rulesets/branch protection are not currently configured in the repository; this gate is therefore a CI enforcement layer, not yet a server-side immutable branch rule.
A malicious actor with repository-admin authority could disable workflows or alter the checkpoint; repository permissions remain an external governance boundary.
unknowns: Fresh GitHub Actions run result for the checkpoint commit has not been independently observed through the available connector surface.
This checkpoint does not prove Cloudflare production runtime behavior.
next_action: Keep the protected-progress gate enabled. For the next protected change: execute the smallest surgical change, verify it, then advance this checkpoint to that verified commit before another protected change.
truth_rules: A newer commit is not automatically a better state
No checkpoint may erase or rewrite historical evidence
failure_behavior: FAIL CLOSED. Do not redesign, reset, restore from memory, or silently overwrite protected work. Identify the first divergence, preserve the evidence, and leave one executable repair action.
